ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 45% low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central regions on both lobes; dense low-intensity stippling and mottling radiating from the leading edge and median notch. Low-intensity pixels form a solid perimeter along the outer lateral and trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 110 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 12% relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-10 pixel depth variations) along the continuous linear boundary of both trailing lobes, creating a jagged profile against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the median notch to the tips; convex curve fitted to the leading edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast multi-tonal (white, beige, and dark brown) jagged pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of fine, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; both dark-on-white and light-on-dark streaks are visible, particularly in the central high-intensity zones of the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent external biological accretions (barnacles) at both distal tips; irregular secondary notch/lesion visible on the left side of the primary median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'salt and pepper' pixel distribution pattern across the ventral surface, creating a unique non-homogenous texture.
